meta.title: STARBONDS — The social network for artists
meta.description: Show your art, sell it, and find artists to collaborate with.

landing.eyebrow: For artists who deserve to be seen
landing.title: Your art, seen. Your talent, connected.
landing.subtitle: STARBONDS is the social network where emerging artists show their work, sell it without middlemen, and match with other artists to collaborate.
landing.featureVisibilityBody: Our feed lifts up people who are just starting out, not only those with thousands of followers.
landing.featureMarketBody: List artworks and commissioned services, and talk directly with buyers.
landing.featureMatchBody: Pick your mediums, styles, and goals, and find like-minded artists to create with.
